subject: AUG conversation memory import
body: User requirement: preserve AUG as lived conversation memory, not merely summaries. Preserve user and assistant words, timestamps, conversation IDs, titles, parent relationships, corrections, disagreements, failures, changes of mind, and the path by which conclusions formed. Summaries and topic indexes must remain secondary pointers to original exchanges. Verified export inventory: 386 conversations, 31,843 messages: 11,150 user and 20,693 assistant. The repository now contains local/dore-local/import_aug_conversations.py, a loss-preserving importer. Inspect and test it, then use it when the AUG export is available to Doré Local. Verify exact counts and spot-check retrieval of surrounding dialogue. If ordinary recall cannot retrieve aug-history with conversational context, improve recall so it can, retaining provenance. Preserve evidence and report exact results, losses or unsupported content types, and remaining improvements. Continue through implementation, test, revision and evidence-backed completion without relying on the user as a message relay.
